capabilities: Synchronize notes and attachments two-way across devices via a self-hosted Cloudflare backend
Create conflict copies for concurrent edits and restore files from version history
Provision the Workers, D1 and R2 backend and device packages with a setup wizard
Manage independent device tokens and isolated cloud vaults from a web management page
extras: The plugin interface is currently Chinese only. The community directory entry was awaiting automated review, so manual installation may be needed. No end-to-end encryption: the Cloudflare account owner and backend administrator can access data. Sync propagates deletions and is explicitly not a backup. Cloudflare may require a payment method to activate R2, though no paid Workers plan is purchased.
intentEvidence: This is a community project, not the official Obsidian Sync service.
problem: Obsidian's official Sync is a developer-hosted service, so users who want vault synchronization through their own storage infrastructure have no built-in option.

relations.evidence: This is a community project, not the official Obsidian Sync service.
Sync an Obsidian vault across desktop, iPhone and Android using your own Cloudflare account.

requires.name: Cloudflare account with Workers, D1 and R2

summary: Self-hosted vault sync across desktop and mobile using your own Cloudflare Workers, D1 and R2 backend, with conflict copies and file history restore.
